verdict.rationale: Vercel's own CLI telemetry docs give two opt-out methods: the `vercel telemetry disable` command and the `VERCEL_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1` environment variable. They also document `vercel telemetry status` and a debug mode that stops data from being sent. The documented scope is the CLI only. missing for 10: evidence of opt-out from usage tracking beyond the CLI (dashboard, plugin, MCP, platform-level analytics), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: You may opt-out of telemetry data collection by running vercel telemetry disable
Alternatively, you may opt-out by setting an environment variable: VERCEL_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1.
